tables.Name: private.admin_login_approvals
tables.Purpose: Records session-bound administrator login requests and approval decisions. Approval alone does not authorize the requesting browser; current device proof and fresh TOTP are also required for replacement.

Columns.Name: id
Columns.Description: Identifies the approval request.

Columns.Name: user_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the administrator requesting access.

Columns.Name: requesting_session_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the Auth session awaiting authorization.
Columns.Extra: Part of composite UQ (requesting_session_id, session_scope); the pair must be unique, not either column individually.

Columns.Name: approver_session_id
Columns.Description: Records the Auth session that decided the request. Deleting that session clears this attribution without deleting the request.

Columns.Name: session_scope
Columns.Description: Separates dashboard login from attendance-scanner login.
Columns.Extra: CHECK dashboard or attendance. Part of composite UQ (requesting_session_id, session_scope); the pair must be unique, not either column individually.

Columns.Name: device_label
Columns.Description: Describes the requesting browser for the approval notification. The request function limits the label to 180 characters; text has no declared character length.

Columns.Name: status
Columns.Description: Records the decision state. Expiration is calculated from timestamps and is not an additional stored status.
Columns.Extra: Default pending. CHECK pending, approved, denied, or cancelled.

Columns.Name: requested_at
Columns.Description: Records creation of the request.

Columns.Name: expires_at
Columns.Description: Limits how long the pending request may be decided.

Columns.Name: decided_at
Columns.Description: Records when approval or denial was recorded.

Columns.Name: approval_expires_at
Columns.Description: Retains the approval-validity boundary. A valid approval does not replace the current trusted-device and authorized-session checks.

Columns.Name: trusted_device_id
Columns.Description: Snapshots the trusted device being replaced. Deliberately not a foreign key: historical requests must survive replacement of the trusted row.

tables.Name: private.admin_trusted_devices
tables.Purpose: Stores one current trusted browser public key per administrator account. Browser trust is fixed at thirty days and is separate from normal account logout and phone-camera pairing.

Columns.Name: user_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the administrator. The primary key permits at most one trusted-browser row per administrator.

Columns.Name: device_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the browser key in the application. It is not globally unique and is not a hardware identifier.

Columns.Name: public_key
Columns.Description: Stores the ECDSA P-256 public JWK used to verify device signatures. The private key remains non-extractable in browser IndexedDB.

Columns.Name: device_label
Columns.Description: Stores the descriptive label of the trusted browser.

Columns.Name: registered_at
Columns.Description: Records registration of the current trusted browser.

Columns.Name: expires_at
Columns.Description: Records the trust expiration set thirty days after registration. Routine reuse does not extend this boundary.

Columns.Name: last_seen_at
Columns.Description: Records recent browser activity maintained by the security workflow. It does not prove that a physical device is online.

tables.Name: private.admin_device_sessions
tables.Purpose: Binds a candidate or authorized administrator Auth session to a browser key, signing challenge and application scope. Unverified candidates cannot access protected application data.

Columns.Name: session_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the Auth session being challenged or authorized.

Columns.Name: user_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the administrator associated with the session.

Columns.Name: device_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the candidate browser. No foreign key is declared because a candidate may not yet be trusted.

Columns.Name: session_scope
Columns.Description: Identifies the application scope being authorized.

Columns.Name: public_key
Columns.Description: Binds the challenge and authorized session to the submitted public key.

Columns.Name: challenge
Columns.Description: Stores the random session-bound signing message. Successful completion consumes the challenge.

Columns.Name: challenge_expires_at
Columns.Description: Limits the challenge to a ten-minute verification window established by the creation function.

Columns.Name: authorized_until
Columns.Description: Remains empty before authorization and cannot exceed the current trusted-device expiration after completion.
